editorial.blurb: Chef Otto Phan's intimate omakase counter—just eight seats, one seating nightly—showcases pristine wild-caught fish sourced daily from Tokyo's markets, each piece explained and prepared with meticulous care.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the counter facing Chef Otto and eat each piece the moment he places it in front of you—don't wait for the diner beside you, as timing is part of the experience. Arrive at the single 6:30 p.m. seating ready to be fully present.
